pdf_page_count reads the page count of a PDF without rendering a page

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	pdf_bytesBytes, pdf_bytesBytesErr := os.ReadFile(`pdf/sample_contract.pdf`)
	if pdf_bytesBytesErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("read fixture pdf/sample_contract.pdf: %v", pdf_bytesBytesErr))
	}
	result, err := xberg.PdfPageCount(pdf_bytesBytes, nil)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
